name: TIDAL Controller
author: Gustavo Muller
description: Control TIDAL without leaving your workspace. A compact Omarchy bar player for TIDAL web and TIDAL Rust, with album art, play/pause, track skipping, seeking and quick window access. Follows your desktop theme and adds a live 64-band spectrum and volume controls for the Rust player.

schema.label: Player source (auto, rust, or web session)

barWidget.description: TIDAL web and native playback controls, album artwork, source selection and a live native spectrum.
